decisions.base: 720-card Base checklist, seven original release series; one card per number; do not multiply uncorrected errors.
decisions.rookies: TCDB identifies 85 unique Base rookie numbers, including multi-player Rookie Stars; preserve full subject/team identities.
decisions.inserts: Three pack-issued 24-piece inserts: Booklets, Posters, Scratch-Offs.
decisions.series: Seven original series; High Number series #634-720. Keep as a single Base product set, then review distribution before release.
decisions.pack: Original wax packs were 10 cards for $0.10; VCS standard 4 cards per pack and 24 packs per box; pack-insert frequencies unverified and intentionally null.
decisions.release: UNRELEASED. Require card images, price, series-aware odds, team QA.
